derived_fields.register: constitutive == yes ? govern : direction_of_fit(force) — derived, never stored. Storing it is an error.
derived_fields.diataxis: force x intention, where the register is know or do.
derived_fields.direction-of-fit: fixed by force — see the table below.

optional_fields.hash: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> — the fixity seal of a frozen record (scripts/hash_seal.py mints it, scripts/hash_check.py verifies it).
optional_fields.verb: generative verb; stored only when it diverges from the tuple (force, intention).
optional_fields.id: ULID (ADR-028) — the stable machine identity, independent of the filename.
optional_fields.slug: the filename stem — the human-readable identity paired with `id`.
optional_fields.concerns: the activities a document governs, distinct from its provenance.
optional_fields.distance: recipient distance — how far the reader sits from the act (theorising, essay 2).
optional_fields.power: the sanction the recipient holds over the act (theorising, essay 2).
optional_fields.retention: the reified retention rule — how long a record is kept live before archival (theorising, essay 3).
optional_fields.supersedes: the record(s) this one supersedes — record chaining (theorising, essay 3: supersede-not-edit).
optional_fields.superseded-by: the record(s) that supersede this one — the inverse of `supersedes`, kept symmetric.
optional_fields.phase: the construction phase this document was written for, or is current as of (steering/roadmap.md, steering/foundation.md) — distinct from `provenance`, which names the activity, not the phase.
optional_fields.pin: a submodule commit pin — the VCS fixity bond for a cross-project reference (writing/frontmatter.md; structuring/setup.md). Not yet exercised in this corpus: this repo is a single-project (topology A) instance, never a `projects/`-submodule one — the field is real, designed vocabulary for the methodology, just structurally unreachable here.

still_open: distance/power allowed values — the sets above are the current practice, not a ruling
status vocabulary — current documents vs frozen records use different words
